sent:
Nina — precise teardown, mobile-first.

What’s breaking flow on mobile now (observed)
- Hero is generic: “See LayerLock in action” with no outcome or stack specifics in the first screen.
- 10+ required fields before any time is shown. Then: “We review submissions within 3–5 business days. If qualified…” No calendar.
- Required qualifiers (“How did you hear about us?”, use case, compliance focus) and exits beside the CTA (“Prefer email?”, one‑pager download).

Three concrete tests
1) Outcome-led hero vs. generic
   - Variant A (CSPM): “Find and fix cloud misconfigurations in minutes — agentless across AWS, GCP, Azure.”
     Subhead: “Live 45‑minute walkthrough with a Solutions Architect. See guardrails, auto‑remediation, data‑flow mapping.”
   - Variant B (Compliance): “Pass SOC 2 faster without slowing releases.”
     Subhead: “Agentless across AWS/GCP/Azure with out‑of‑the‑box SOC 2/ISO/PCI dashboards.”
   - Measure: mobile form‑start and booked‑meeting rate per variant.

2) 2‑field + instant calendar vs. long gate
   - Show only Work email + Company. On submit, reveal an inline calendar to book immediately.
   - Move clouds/size/compliance/phone/referral to an after‑booking page as optional tailoring.
   - Microcopy above calendar: “Meet a Solutions Architect for 45 minutes. Bring a workload—we’ll show it agentless.”
   - Measure: bookings per mobile session, time‑to‑meeting, show‑rate.

3) Gate + link treatment
   - Replace “3–5 business days/if qualified” with speed + trust: “Pick a time now. You’ll meet a Solutions Architect.” Add: “Now SOC 2 Type I; ISO 27001 in progress.”
   - Collapse “Prefer email?” and the one‑pager below the fold on mobile (or move to confirmation).
   - Measure: drop‑off at final step; exits to email/download.

Execution details that help on mobile
- Sticky “Book a demo” anchoring to the calendar section.
- Correct input modes (email keyboard for email; numeric if phone ever shown). Default Country from IP.
- Pull homepage proof (logos + “cut audit prep from weeks to days” quote) adjacent to the calendar.

Success metric: confirmed calendar bookings / unique mobile sessions on /request‑demo, with show‑rate tracked separately.

If you want, I’ll send a marked‑up version with placements and screenshots.
